3 (a) There was heavy rainfall on Ischia on 26 November 2022.
Rainfall is part of the water cycle.
Complete the sentences about the water cycle.
Use words from the list. Each word may be used once, more than once or not at all.
atmosphere condensation evaporation gas
interception liquid run-off
soil solid through-flow
The process of water turning from a liquid to a gas is ______ .
Water transfers from the leaves of plants to the atmosphere as a ______ .
More water is transported through the plant and to the leaves from the ______ .
The movement of water on the land surface is called ______ .

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A few hours after the heavy rainfall on Ischia, a large section of Mount Epomeo moved
towards the sea. This caused large quantities of mud and loose rock to flow through the town
of Casamicciola Terme.
The photograph shows some of the damage caused by this landslide.
11 people were killed by the landslide and many people were injured. Drinking water was
contaminated with sewage.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Suggest two other impacts of the landslide on people.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
The island has illegally constructed buildings. Large areas of land on the island have
been cleared of vegetation for these buildings.
Suggest why removing vegetation makes landslides more likely to happen.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Suggest one reason why illegal construction makes landslides more likely to happen,
other than removing vegetation.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Ischia is a popular tourist destination. Approximately 6 million tourists visit the island each
year.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Illegal construction and increased use of vehicles are negative impacts of tourism.
Suggest two other negative impacts of tourism on Ischia.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Suggest a suitable transport policy that would reduce the impact of the 6 million tourists
on the island. Explain how the policy reduces the impact.
policy ______
explanation ______

5 Mount Epomeo is an extinct volcano. The volcano last erupted in 1302.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Igneous rock is found in many parts of Ischia.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Describe how igneous rock forms.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Name one igneous rock.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Some rocks are extracted from subsurface mines.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State three factors that affect the decision to extract rocks.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Suggest one reason why subsurface mining is more dangerous than surface mining.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Describe the social benefits of rock extraction to local people.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text:
The photograph shows a landscape damaged by rock extraction.
State two negative impacts of rock extraction shown in the photograph.

parts.label: (v)
parts.text:
Landscapes damaged by rock extraction can be restored by bioremediation.
Describe bioremediation.

State what should be included in a disaster plan. Give four answers.
